8264.title: Installed launcher replaces a managed CLI connection
8264.rootCauseOneLine: The npm launcher resolves installed config before BB_CLI delegation, replacing the loopback authentication-proxy URL; the CLI then contacts upstream without the proxy-injected machine header.
8264.proposedFix: Preserve the supplied managed CLI connection during delegation while retaining standalone installed configuration. Automatic repair is excluded because authentication configuration precedence changes.
8264.caveats: Two clean Linux checkouts, real built launcher/CLI and real machine-auth proxy, synthetic header-checking upstream. Native macOS installation and the reporter's backend were not tested. Complete regression test is embedded inline per reports repository policy.
